decisions.decision: Five modules map to routes: Commons→/workspace/commons, Network→/workspace/network/{people,institutions,capabilities}, Workbench→/workspace/workbench/{field-desk}, Records→/workspace/records/{canon,annals,roll}, Intelligence→/workspace/intelligence/{coin-lab}. StudioContext keys: commons, network:people|institutions|capabilities, workbench|workbench:field-desk, records:canon|annals|roll, intelligence:coin-lab.
decisions.rationale: Charter mandates five modules, one workspace. Current seven labels map cleanly: Radar=Commons, Network=Network (with three sub-contexts, not separate routes), Undertakings=Workbench, Roll+Annals=Records lenses, APT Coin Lab→Intelligence (analysis/forecasting job), School Console=nested boundary under Network→Institutions (operational-boundary exception per §4).
decisions.risk: Network sub-contexts must not become separate rail items; use sidebar context switcher. Records module must not feel like three disconnected pages—lens switcher in page head.

decisions.decision: Canon, Annals, Roll are three lenses over one ledger backed by RollEntry (hash_anchor, evidence layers public/participant/restricted, acceptance block, RollRevision), WorkEvent history, 34 typed relationships, and recordBasis values. Ship order: Roll lens first (most complete: hash anchors, evidence layers, acceptance), then Annals (prototype exists), then Canon (distributed in people-network, needs dedicated view). Each lens shows: Canon—entities, identities, typed relationships, accepted state; Annals—chronological WorkEvent stream with actors/decisions/transitions; Roll—evidence, provenance, attestations, verification, hash_anchor chain.
decisions.rationale: Charter §5 requires conceptual distinction with shared navigation. Repo has RollEntry with hash_anchor+evidence layers+acceptance (Roll), WorkEvent[] with history (Annals), people-network entities+relationships (Canon). Roll ships first because its data model is complete and validates the evidence-first principle.
decisions.risk: Must not duplicate data fetching across lenses. Single ledger service with lens-specific projections.

decisions.decision: Per-record/proposal state machine: draft → proposed → in_review → pending_authorization → authorized → in_execution → pending_acceptance → accepted → (amended|rejected|cancelled). Fork glyph attaches at proposed (identity device for proposed change-set). Each state preserves charter's never-equate distinctions: draft≠proposed (intent≠submission), proposed≠in_review (submission≠active review), in_review≠pending_authorization (review≠decision), pending_authorization≠authorized (awaiting≠granted), authorized≠in_execution (permission≠action), in_execution≠pending_acceptance (doing≠verifying), pending_acceptance≠accepted (candidate≠confirmed), accepted≠amended (original≠corrected), accepted≠settled (acceptance≠value transfer). Derived from workbench-simulation 6 stages (tender-review→assembly→delivery→acceptance→deployment→pause/resume/cancel) + local-workflows (submitted→under_review→selected/declined) + RollEntry acceptance block.
decisions.rationale: Charter §3 demands preservation of 12 distinctions. Current simulation stages + workflow states + Roll acceptance map to a single state machine that makes authority visible at each transition. Fork glyph is identity only (per user ruling), not navigation.
decisions.risk: State machine must be enforced by backend/local persistence, not just UI. Demo mode throws on persistence—needs resolution.

decisions.decision: Topbar: brand, workspace name, global search, user avatar (no environment switcher). Rail: exactly five module icons (Commons, Network, Workbench, Records, Intelligence). Sidebar: context switcher for Network (people/institutions/capabilities) and Records lens picker (Canon/Annals/Roll). Main: page head with hierarchy (eyebrow/module → h1/record name → subtitle → metrics only where they drive decisions). Inspector: contextual record inspector (not static module text), shown on selection. Dock: changeset/evidence ledger for active proposal (not static tabs duplicating rail). Statusbar: real system state (head, sync, demo mode).
decisions.rationale: Charter §4: no competing navigation systems; each chrome surface has exactly one job. Current shell has inspector only for roll/apt-coin-lab, dock duplicating rail links, static module-context text. Must unify to: rail=module nav, sidebar=context within module, inspector=selected record, dock=active changeset.
decisions.risk: Responsive collapse must preserve access to all five modules on mobile (mobile-nav pattern from v1 studies).

Changeset state machine enforces 10 states with fork glyph at proposed; never-equate distinctions visible in UI (e.g., authorized≠in_execution badge)
No Main/Branch switcher in topbar; no environment token in URL
Dock shows active changeset/evidence (not static tabs); inspector shows selected record (not static module text)
Network module has sidebar context switcher (people/institutions/capabilities) not separate rail items
APT Coin Lab accessible at /workspace/intelligence/coin-lab under Intelligence rail item
School Console remains at /workspace/institutions/school-console as nested boundary
npm run build passes with no TypeScript errors
thesis: The v2 workspace must collapse seven current labels (Radar, Network, Undertakings, Roll, Annals, APT Coin Lab, School Console) into five modules (Commons, Network, Workbench, Records, Intelligence) by migrating routes, unifying Records as a single module with three lenses (Canon, Annals, Roll), grounding changeset semantics in the existing 6-stage workbench pipeline plus roll acceptance states, and removing the Main/Branch switcher, duplicate navigation, and static inspector/dock chrome. Apt Coin Lab lands under Intelligence as a contextual view; School Console remains a nested operational boundary under Network → Institutions.
